name: Equity Game
summary: Equity Game is a free-to-play multiplayer mobile game for Android and iOS. Players compete in arcade minigames with individual leaderboards and climb a global ranking with leagues and emblems. Each player builds an island whose main building, the Nexus, generates passive Karma and improves as the player levels up. Players can join alliances of up to fifty members and choose from 46 avatars, each with its own story, style and frame. The game also includes an optional blockchain theme that players can learn about along the way, though no prior knowledge is required to play.
